title: 第五章 六识

content_zh:
寒风虽劲，但阳光明媚，极目四顾，但见群山莽莽，直让人心胸俱阔。
神武和云中，同处于群山环抱的一片盆地当中，从神武到云中，从汉时就开辟驰道可通，足可通行车马。再过云中向北出群山，就是茫茫草原。
汉武帝时，常常在云中之地集结数万甚至十万大军，北攻匈奴，深入漠南。就是道路可以撑持大军的物资转运。
但徐乐他们一行，并没有走群山环抱之间的那条驰道。反而深入群山之间，沿着商队开辟出来的羊肠小道，鱼贯而行。
原因并没有什么复杂的，现下大业天子南去，各地郡守称得上是割据为雄。在马邑郡内，还有郡守王仁恭和坐镇云中的鹰击郎将刘武周之间的明争暗斗。
这些道路上，都已经遍布税卡，都想在过往商队中狠狠吸上几口血。这些资财，就变成了各地守臣扩充部下实力的助力。
徐乐这么一支小小商队，要是真的沿着官道过云中而入草原，估计二十驮子的货物，一路这样抽税，到了地头连小半都未必剩得下来。
所谓乱世将至，表现形式之一就是原来维系一个大帝国运转的法度渐渐崩坏。
但在山道中穿行，比之走在官道上就不知道辛苦到哪里去了。餐风露宿，路上没有亭堡，狂风暴雨，风刀霜剑，都得自己扛着。
山中野兽，也都得防范。而且世道渐渐崩坏，盗匪马贼再度兴起。突厥游骑，不时深入云中左近的群山之间。遇上这些家伙，就得拼命！
此时行商，真是拿命在拼搏。若是跟随还健硕的徐老太公一路向北，从庄客到侠少，心中还有些底气。但是此刻却跟着初出茅庐的乐郎君，不论是侠少还是闾中庄客，人人兢兢业业，提心吊胆。
一路行来，已经十余日的功夫，早已深入群山之中。
众人只觉得精力体力在这十余日中，消耗得飞快，人人都是一副疲乏的模样。就是驮马乘马这些牲口，似乎也感受到了主人们紧张的气氛，在这山道之中连嘶鸣声都变得少了。
只有徐乐，还是那副神采奕奕，风流蕴藉的模样的。同样一副短衣窄袖的行路人打扮，硬是给他穿出世家子弟的味道。仿佛是出来踏青的五陵少年，这一趟大家赌上命的行商之路就是来找乐子的。
马蹄声声中，队伍上到一个山头高处，这个时候红日已经擦着西面山檐，将这小小商队的人马影子在山头上拉得老长。
徐乐当先攀上高处，四下张望一眼，手划了个圈笑道：“就在这里歇息吧！地方干爽，视线开阔。除了风大一点没别的毛病！”
一众庄客侠少陆续跟上，听到徐乐下令休息。众人沉默就将货物搬下驮子，给坐骑松马肚带，还有人去劈柴找水，几名侠少也没闲着，忙忙碌碌的开始设起晚上过夜的营地。
一名四十出头的老庄客也爬到高处看了一眼：“没走错，再有两天，就能绕过云中。继续再在山里走七程的路，就出山进了草原。乐郎君你第一次出门，居然方向辨识得这么清楚，当真不容易！”
徐乐一笑不以为意，自己也犯不着告诉庄客，爷爷从小就聚米为山，堆叠出他走过的冲要所在的山川地势，教自己如何分辨借用地势，教导自己如何在野外记清方向。一路行来，就是将爷爷的教导一条条在心底验证，结果发现自己在这方面还颇有天赋，学得不错。
爷爷教导这一身本事，怎么也不会是让自己终老在神武县做准备的，偏生就不愿意告诉自己身世，平日里也生怕自己踏出照拂范围内一步，这矛盾的心思，真是为难爷爷了。

正在准备要也去帮手准备营地之际，徐乐突然耳朵一动。
周遭尽是山林，虽然寒风已然劲厉，但枝叶尚未凋残完毕，仍然莽莽榛榛，一路行来，能听见狐兔响动的声音，却在这茫茫山林之中却看不见踪迹。
就山顶之处，有一片平地，虽然无遮无挡，风势迫人，晚上寒气估计能浸到人骨头里，可徐乐选在此间扎营，就是为了视野开阔，保证安全。
这个选择，庄客和侠少们都没有半点意见。行走在外，就是要吃得这份苦头。
就在刚才，徐乐听闻到脚下不远处，山林中似乎隐隐有枯枝踏断之声。而包括韩约在内，庄客侠少们却没一个感觉到有动静的。

content_en:
Although the cold wind is strong, the sun is shining brightly. Looking around, I can see the vast mountains, which makes me feel broad-minded.
Shenwu and Yunzhong are both located in a basin surrounded by mountains. From Shenwu to Yunzhong, a road has been opened since the Han Dynasty, which is enough for carriages and horses. Beyond the clouds and out of the mountains to the north is the vast grassland.
During the reign of Emperor Wu of the Han Dynasty, he often assembled tens of thousands or even hundreds of thousands of troops in the land of clouds to attack the Huns from the north and penetrate deep into the desert. That is, the road can support the transportation of materials for the army.
But Xu Le and his party did not take the galloping road surrounded by mountains. Instead, they went deep into the mountains and followed the narrow paths opened by the caravans.
The reason is not complicated. Now that Emperor Daye has gone south, the county guards in various places can be said to be separatist. In Mayi County, there was also an open and covert struggle between the county governor Wang Rengong and the Eagle Striker General Liu Wuzhou who was in charge of Yunzhong.
These roads are already covered with tax cards, and they all want to suck a few mouthfuls of blood from the passing caravans. These assets became a help for the guards in various places to expand the strength of their subordinates.
If a small caravan like Xu Le really followed the official road through the clouds and entered the grassland, it is estimated that even less than half of the twenty loads of goods would be left with such taxes at the end of the field.
The so-called troubled times are coming, and one of the manifestations is the gradual collapse of the laws that originally maintained the operation of a large empire.
But walking on the mountain road is much harder than walking on the official road. They had to sleep in the open air, there were no pavilions or forts on the road, and they had to carry the wind, rain, wind and frost swords by themselves.
You also have to be on guard against wild beasts in the mountains. Moreover, the world is gradually collapsing, and bandits and horse thieves are rising again. Turks rode from time to time deep into the mountains near Yunzhong. When you encounter these guys, you have to fight tooth and nail!
At this time, businessmen are really fighting for their lives. If you follow the still strong old Mrs. Xu all the way north, from Zhuang Ke to Xia Shao Shao, you will still have some confidence in your heart. But now, following the fledgling Lelangjun, everyone, whether he is a young knight or a villager in the village, is working diligently and fearfully.
Along the way, it has been more than ten days, and we have already penetrated deep into the mountains.
Everyone felt that their energy and physical strength had been consumed very quickly in these ten days, and everyone looked tired. Even the packhorses and other animals seemed to feel the tense atmosphere of their owners, and even the neighing sounds became less in this mountain road.
Only Xu Le still looked energetic and charming. He was also dressed like a pedestrian in a short coat and narrow sleeves, giving him the air of a member of a noble family. It was like a young man from Wuling who came out for an outing. Everyone was just looking for fun on this business trip where they risked their lives.
Amidst the sound of horse hooves, the team reached a high point on the mountain. At this time, the red sun was already grazing the eaves of the mountain in the west, making the shadows of the small caravan's people and horses long on the mountain.
Xu Le first climbed up to the height, looked around, made a circle with his hand and said with a smile: "Just rest here! The place is dry and the view is wide. There is no other problem except that it is windy!"
A group of villagers and knights followed one after another and heard Xu Le's order to rest. Everyone was silent as they unloaded the goods on the pack bags, loosened the girdle of the horses, and others went to chop wood and find water. Several young heroes were also busy and started to set up a camp for the night.
An old villager in his early forties also climbed to a high place and took a look: "You are right. In two days, you can bypass Yunzhong. Continue walking in the mountains for another seven miles and then you will be out of the mountains and into the grassland. Mr. Lelang, it is your first time to go out, and you can identify the direction so clearly. It is really not easy!"
Xu Le smiled and didn't take it seriously. He didn't have to tell the banker that his grandfather had gathered rice into mountains since he was a child. He stacked up the mountains and rivers where he walked and taught himself how to identify the terrain and how to remember the direction clearly in the wild. Along the way, I verified my grandfather's teachings in my heart one by one. It turned out that I was quite talented in this area and learned well.The skills my grandpa taught me would never prepare me to live in Shenwu County for the rest of my life. He was reluctant to tell me his life experience, and he was usually afraid of taking a step outside the scope of his care. This contradictory mentality really embarrassed my grandpa.
Just as he was preparing to help prepare the camp, Xu Le's ears suddenly twitched.
There are mountains and forests all around. Although the cold wind is already strong, the branches and leaves have not yet withered and are still wild. Along the way, you can hear the sounds of foxes and rabbits, but there is no trace in this vast mountain forest.
There is a piece of flat land on the top of the mountain. Although it is unobstructed and the wind is strong, and the cold at night is probably soaked into one's bones, Xu Le chose to camp here to have a wide view and ensure safety.
Neither the banker nor the knights had any objections to this choice. When you walk outside, you have to endure this hardship.
Just now, Xu Le heard the faint sound of dead branches breaking in the forest not far from his feet. Including Han Yue, none of the Zhuangke Xia young men felt any movement.
